import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a boxplot comparing price by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=df, palette='Set2')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)

# Rotate x labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a boxplot comparing price by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=df, palette='Set2')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)

# Rotate x labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
